name: Portable generator

combustion.note: Never indoors, in a garage or a shed: run it at least 6 m (20 ft) from buildings with the exhaust pointed away from doors and windows (Health Canada CO). A CO shut-off doesn't replace CO alarms. kW is the fuel a 2.2 kW Honda burns from 1/4 to full load.

notes: A Honda EU2200i inverter generator turns only about 11–18% of its petrol's energy into electricity (Honda EU2200i run times; AFDC fuel properties); other models differ. Use it for the furnace blower, pumps, lights and the fridge, and burn fuel for heat in a heater made for it.

sources.title: Honda EU2200i: Honda Power Equipment, EU2200i Super Quiet Series generator technical specifications (Honda news)
